name: The Kidnappers Eyes
source:
You are the same protagonist (Inconigt), someone with family problems, looking for a job to move to in this game.

But be careful, because a certain person plans to change your boring life completely!

Your duty is to choose which path to choose. If you choose wrong in the following days until the end, things can end badly.

[From [url=https://starlingt.itch.io/the-kidnappers-eyes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是同一个主角（Inconigt），一个有家庭问题的人，在这个游戏中寻找一份工作。

但要小心，因为某个人打算彻底改变你无聊的生活！

你的职责是选择选择哪条路。如果在接下来的日子里直到最后你选择错误，事情可能会很糟糕。

[来自[url=https://starlingt.itch.io/the-kidnappers-eyes]Itch.io[/url]]
